page_title: GET 1-1 LEV | Getafe v Levante 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Mateo Busquets has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Total attempts – 11:11.

90+3' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) has a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better as his effort ends wide of the left post.
90+2' Etta Eyong (Levante) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Levante.

90+1' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Levante.
90+1' The corner from Alex Sancris (Getafe) is intercepted by the defence.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Coba da Costa (Getafe) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Getafe.
89' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Levante.
88' Yvan Neyou (Getafe) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mateo Busquets who sees an offensive foul.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ivan Romero trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jose Morales (Levante).
82' The whistle blows and Allan Nyom (Getafe) is booked for an infringement.
81' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Davinchi (Getafe), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
80' Etta Eyong (Levante) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
79' Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.
77' Substitution. Javier Munoz makes way for Yvan Neyou (Getafe).
77' Today's match ends for Borja Mayoral who will be replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) will replace Roger Brugue.
74' Julian Calero prepares a substitution. Carlos Alvarez is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
71' The referee blows for a cooling break.
69' The attendance is 7749.
68' It looks like Roger Brugue (Levante) saw red with that tackle. Mateo Busquets won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
67' The ratio of the ball possession is 57:43.
66' Alex Sancris (Getafe) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
64' Coba da Costa (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
63' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. A free kick to Getafe.
62' Here is a change. Kervin Arriaga is going off and Julian Calero gives the last tactical orders to Oriol Rey (Levante).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) comes onto the pitch for Unai Vencedor.
61' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle as Roger Brugue (Levante) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
60' Unai Vencedor (Levante) is able to continue to play.
59' Unai Vencedor (Levante) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
57' 1 - 1 GOAL! Abdel Abqar meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:1.
56' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.
55' The referee points to the corner flag and Getafe will take a corner.
55' Coba da Costa (Getafe) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
52' The ball is cleared after Coba da Costa (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
52' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe).
50' Alex Sancris (Getafe) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
49' The keeper makes a simple save after Coba da Costa (Getafe) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
47' The Levante players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Kiko Femenia comes on the pitch for Domingos Duarte (Getafe).
46' Referee Mateo Busquets blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Ivan Romero (Levante) latches onto the free kick from Unai Vencedor, but heads just wide of the left post from close range.
45+3' Rough tackle by Abdel Abqar (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Levante will take a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Etta Eyong (Levante) takes a first-time shot from inside the box, but his poor effort flies way wide of the right post.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Abdel Abqar (Getafe) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Djene will be replaced by Alex Sancris (Getafe).
40' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Coba da Costa (Getafe) comes onto the pitch so that Mario Martin can be given a rest.
39' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Davinchi (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Getafe win a corner kick.
35' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
35' Mario Martin (Getafe) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
34' Mario Martin (Getafe) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' One of the Getafe players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
32' The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
32' Davinchi (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
29' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
28' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Roger Brugue (Levante), but the defence gets it clear.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Roger Brugue finds Ivan Romero (Levante) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
25' Davinchi (Getafe) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
25' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

24' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
22' Flag goes up against Etta Eyong (Levante) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
20' Manu Sanchez (Levante) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
19' Ivan Romero (Levante) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
19' Javier Munoz (Getafe) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
15' Manu Sanchez (Levante) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
13' Ivan Romero (Levante) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but David Soria tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
12' Unai Vencedor (Levante) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
11' Unai Vencedor (Levante) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
10' Levante couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as David Soria (Getafe) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
9' Djene (Getafe) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.

9' Unai Vencedor (Levante) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mateo Busquets blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
7' Matias Moreno (Levante) sends a long ball in, but David Soria comfortably gathers the ball.
6' Mateo Busquets interrupts the game. One of the players from Levante won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
5' Getafe seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Levante work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
1' Davinchi (Getafe) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets is the one to supervise the game today.
